company.name: KRISPR
company.shortDescription: KRISPR is an innovative indoor vertical farming brand focused on producing fresh, sustainable, and chemical-free vegetables.
company.description: KRISPR is a Dubai-based agri-tech company transforming modern agriculture through indoor vertical farming solutions. Founded in 2015, the company combines science, hydroponics, and environmental control systems to cultivate nutrient-rich, pesticide-free greens and herbs year-round. KRISPR focuses on sustainability by reducing water consumption, minimizing food miles, and delivering freshly harvested produce directly to consumers and retailers. The company aims to strengthen regional food security while promoting healthier, eco-friendly food production practices in the Middle East.
